title: BurgerIndex
description: The single dataset the Python pipeline writes to data/burger_index.json and the Next.js site reads at build time. Prices are USD. Keep this file, pipeline/models, and web/src/lib/schema.ts in sync.

index_price_rule.description: Human sentence, e.g. 'Each restaurant is represented by one burger: its highest-priced beef burger, and that burger's price is the restaurant's index price.'

restaurants_priced.description: Restaurant locations with a non-null index_price (each chain location counts here).

burgers.description: Published burgers: one per priced restaurant location (its highest-priced eligible beef burger), so it equals restaurants_priced.

beef_burgers.description: Published beef burgers; every published burger is beef, so it equals burgers.

index_median.description: THE Burger Index: median index_price across distinct menus — each independent restaurant once, each chain once however many locations it has.

all_burgers_median.description: Median price of the published burgers on distinct menus (a chain's menu once). With one burger per restaurant it equals index_median.

cheapest_burger_id.description: The lowest-priced published burger on a distinct menu (each restaurant's one burger is its highest-priced beef burger).

priciest_burger_id.description: The highest-priced published burger on a distinct menu.

burgers.description: Published burgers in the area: one per priced restaurant location.

index_median.description: Median index_price over distinct menus in the area: a chain counts at most once per area.

Burger.description: A restaurant's one published burger: its highest-priced eligible beef burger (one burger for one person; no group platter, combo, eating challenge or kids' item; a Deluxe or with-fries version gives way to the cheaper plain burger on the same menu; dinner or all-day price first; never happy hour). Restaurants without an index_price publish none.

id.description: Globally unique: '<restaurant id>--<item slug>' (suffix -2, -3 on collisions).

is_index_item.description: True for exactly one burger per priced restaurant: its one published burger, whose price is the index_price.

id.description: URL slug, unique. Name + neighborhood (+ short camis suffix on collision).

camis.description: NYC DOHMH restaurant id when matched.

name.description: Display name in normal case (not the DOHMH all-caps dba).

chain.description: Chain brand slug when this location shares a chain-level menu scrape (e.g. 'shake-shack').

menu_url.description: The page the prices were extracted from.

price_source.description: delivery_app prices usually run above in-store prices; the site labels them.

index_price.description: Price of the restaurant's highest-priced eligible beef burger (its one published burger); null unless status == 'priced'.

burgers.description: At most one burger: the one whose price is index_price. Empty unless status == 'priced'.
